title: AG2 sandbox shell restricted mode (readonly=True / allowed=[...]) bypassed by a newline: second line runs any command
attacker_story: The developer gives the agent a shell tool restricted to read-only commands (readonly=True); a prompt-injected model emits 'ls' followed by a newline and a command outside the allow-list, which the prefix check passes and sh -c runs.

oracle.description: /tmp/avb_canary_<nonce> exists: a non-allow-listed command (touch) ran through the read-only shell tool
